facts: February 1979 Khomeini returned to Iran after fourteen years in exile. 4 November 1979 students stormed the US embassy in Tehran; fifty-two Americans were held for 444 days. April 1980 Carter's rescue mission failed in the Iranian desert and eight Americans died. Iran freed the hostages minutes after Reagan's swearing-in on 20 January 1981. The US and Iran have had no diplomatic relations since 1980.

lines.say: In February 1979, Ayatollah Khomeini flew home to Iran after fourteen years in exile. The Shah had already fled.
On November 4th, 1979, students stormed the American embassy in Tehran and took its staff hostage.
Back home, America was furious. Fifty-two Americans would be held for four hundred and forty-four days.
In April 1980, President Carter sent commandos to rescue them. The mission failed in the Iranian desert, and eight Americans died.
Ronald Reagan won that November. Iran freed every hostage minutes after he was sworn in.
The two countries have had no diplomatic relations since.
